title: Pure Vaalmonica
summary: Pure Vaalmonica Pendulum and Link strategy, balancing between angelic Life Point gains and demonic self-inflicted damage. Each Vaalmonica Spell and Trap presents a moral binary that places Resonance Counters on either Angello or Dimonno Vaalmonica, charging up powerful Link-1 fiends and game-ending Link-2 concords.

summary.title: Starters
points: Selettrice Vaalmonica adds any Vaalmonica card from your Deck to your hand upon Normal or Pendulum Summon, and places a Resonance Counter on a scale when sent to the Extra Deck.
Angello Vaalmonica discards a card to place itself and Dimonno Vaalmonica directly into your Pendulum Zones from hand and Deck, accumulating counters whenever you gain LP.
Dimonno Vaalmonica discards a card to place itself and Angello Vaalmonica into the Pendulum Zones, accumulating counters whenever you take effect damage.
Vaalmonica Invitare Special Summons a Level 4 Vaalmonica monster from your Deck or adds both Angello and Dimonno to your hand/Extra Deck.
Vaalmonica, the Agathokakological Voice searches a Vaalmonica monster on activation, places counters, and takes control of an opponent's monster once you accumulate 3 Resonance Counters.

summary.title: Opening: Selettrice + Invitare
steps: Normal Summon Selettrice Vaalmonica to search Vaalmonica Scelta from your Deck.
Activate Vaalmonica Scelta, choosing to take 500 damage to add Vaalmonica Invitare from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Vaalmonica Invitare to place Angello Vaalmonica and Dimonno Vaalmonica directly into your Pendulum Zones.
Activate additional Vaalmonica Spells (Versare or Intonare) to apply LP gain and damage effects, loading 3 Resonance Counters onto your chosen scale.
Link Summon Zebufera, Vaalmonican Hallow Heathen (or Duralume) using Selettrice or a Pendulum Monster while controlling a card with 3 Resonance Counters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: Resonance Scales & Dual Links
points: Angello Vaalmonica acts as Scale 3, gaining a Resonance Counter each time you gain LP and providing a battle negation.
Dimonno Vaalmonica acts as Scale 5, gaining a Resonance Counter each time you take effect damage and granting a second attack on monsters.
Duralume, Vaalmonican Heathen Hallow can attack up to three times per Battle Phase and detaches 3 Resonance Counters to target and destroy opponent monsters up to the number of counters removed.
Zebufera, Vaalmonican Hallow Heathen protects your cards from destruction by removing a Resonance Counter, and copies the effect of any Vaalmonica Normal Spell or Trap in your GY as a Quick Effect.
Varar, Vaalmonican Concord requires 2 monsters including a Vaalmonica Link, is unaffected by non-Vaalmonica effects while you have 6+ total counters, and negates a monster summon as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Vaalmonica Scelta lets you gain 500 LP to cycle cards or take 500 damage to search a Vaalmonica Spell or Trap.
Vaalmonica Versare lets you gain 500 LP to excavate a Vaalmonica card or take 500 damage to send any Vaalmonica card from Deck to GY.
Vaalmonica Intonare lets you gain 500 LP to revive a Vaalmonica monster or take 500 damage to add a Level 4 Vaalmonica from GY to hand.
Vaalmonica Ereditare is a Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a Vaalmonica Link Monster, shuffling back Vaalmonica Spells to draw cards.
Vaalmonica Chosen Melody and Vaalmonica Followed Rhythm offer on-field protection, monster effect negations, and backrow destruction.
